findings.witness: Sampling clock computes due from accumulator/interval, places old next into previous and new target into next once, and computes normal velocities using elapsed=interval*due. Ragdoll seed instead obtains sample_interval() which always returns one configured period. A due=2 transition with positions separated by 0.02m over two 30Hz periods represents0.3m/s but ragdoll seed requests0.6m/s before adding momentum; both below configured10m/s cap. Angular difference shares one-period denominator subject to its 1e-5 floor.
